imports.title: Import
imports.subtitle: Bring your skills, working context and projects into xopc.
imports.detectedHint: Apps found on the device running xopc.
imports.finishedWithIssues: Finished with some items to check
imports.empty: No supported apps found. Use Codex or Claude Code on the device running xopc, then refresh.
imports.footnote: Existing content is preserved. Context documents become searchable reference material. Tool connections need to be reconnected; passwords and sign-in sessions are not imported.
imports.chooseHint: Choose what to bring into xopc. Existing content is preserved; projects and working rules are not selected by default.
imports.incomplete: Some locations could not be scanned. Only the listed items can be imported.
imports.runningHint: You can close this window and view the result later.
imports.retryHint: The result is uncertain. Retry the same selection to avoid duplicate writes.
imports.previewTruncated: Preview shortened. The full document will be imported.
